name: Nerona USD
oneLiner: USDnr is Nerona's 1:1 wrapper of M0's M token backed by short-term U.S. T-bills; T-bill yield accrues to M0 and Nerona, not USDnr holders.
collateral: M token held by the USDnr extension, with indirect exposure to M0's short-duration U.S. Treasury collateral. The reviewed reserve composition identifies the immediate M wrapper claim; no separately measured Stability Reserve buffer is established.
pegMechanism: Non-rebasing 1:1 M0 M-extension: USDnr is minted through the M0 SwapFacility by depositing M or an allowed asset, with the USDC deposit path open to any address (no protocol-level KYC, under an admin-set asset cap) and M-path wrap and unwrap restricted to M-swapper-role addresses, all subject to extension pause and freeze controls. Issuer documentation labels the backing wM, but the extension escrows M directly and holds no wM. Holder redemption, per issuer documentation, converts USDnr 1:1 into M0's T-bill token and sells it for USDC through the wM/USDC Uniswap V3 pool on Ethereum at the 0.01% fee tier, a secondary-market exit rather than issuer fiat redemption. Yield on the escrowed M accrues to a single issuer-configured yield recipient; USDnr holders receive no rebase or NAV growth. The yield-bearing variant sUSDnr (Upshift ERC-4626 vault on Fluent) earns curated DeFi strategy yield, exited via a 4-day standard unwind or a 1% instant fee.
